examples.en: The manager will dictate a letter to her assistant this afternoon.
examples.zh: 經理今天下午會對助理口述一封信。

examples.en: The school rules dictate that students must wear uniforms.
examples.zh: 學校規定學生必須穿制服。

examples.en: Parents should not dictate every choice their children make.
examples.zh: 父母不該決定孩子的每一個選擇。

examples.en: Many people simply follow the dictates of fashion.
examples.zh: 許多人只是跟隨流行的指示。

examples.en: She always listens to the dictates of her conscience.
examples.zh: 她總是聽從良心的指示。

examples.en: The company ignored the dictates of common sense.
examples.zh: 那家公司無視常識的指示。

examples.en: Our English teacher gives us a dictation every Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師每週五早上都會讓我們聽寫。

examples.en: The secretary took dictation while the boss walked around the room.
examples.zh: 老闆在房間裡走動時，秘書記錄他的口述內容。

examples.en: I made three spelling mistakes in the dictation test.
examples.zh: 我在聽寫測驗中拼錯了三個字。

examples.en: Please discard the empty bottles in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 請把空瓶丟進資源回收桶。

examples.en: He discarded his old notes after the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考結束後，他把舊筆記丟掉了。

examples.en: The committee decided to discard the original plan.
examples.zh: 委員會決定放棄原本的計畫。

examples.en: The shop sells clothes made from fabric discards.
examples.zh: 那家店販售用廢棄布料製成的衣服。

examples.en: In the card game, each player puts a discard on the table.
examples.zh: 玩這個紙牌遊戲時，每位玩家都要在桌上放一張棄牌。

examples.en: The artist turned factory discards into beautiful sculptures.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家把工廠的廢棄物變成美麗的雕塑。

examples.en: The noise from the street was a constant disturbance during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間，街上的噪音一直造成干擾。

examples.en: Please do not cause any disturbance in the library.
examples.zh: 請不要在圖書館裡製造任何干擾。

examples.en: Neighbors called the police because of a disturbance late at night.
examples.zh: 鄰居因為深夜的騷動而報警。

examples.en: Freshmen usually live in the dormitory on campus.
examples.zh: 大一新生通常住在校內的宿舍。

examples.en: Each dormitory room has two beds and two desks.
examples.zh: 每間宿舍房間都有兩張床和兩張書桌。

examples.en: The dormitory closes its front door at eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 宿舍在十一點關上大門。

examples.en: The road slopes downward toward the river.
examples.zh: 這條路朝河邊向下傾斜。

examples.en: She looked downward and saw her shoes were untied.
examples.zh: 她往下看，發現鞋帶鬆了。

examples.en: Prices of electronic products have moved downward this year.
examples.zh: 今年電子產品的價格一直往下走。

examples.en: The company reported a downward trend in sales.
examples.zh: 那家公司回報銷售量呈下降趨勢。

examples.en: He made a downward movement with his hand.
examples.zh: 他用手做了一個向下的動作。

examples.en: We took the downward path to the lake.
examples.zh: 我們走向下的小徑到湖邊。

examples.en: Grandpa likes to doze in his chair after lunch.
examples.zh: 爺爺午餐後喜歡坐在椅子上打盹。

examples.en: I dozed during the long speech and missed the ending.
examples.zh: 我在冗長的演講中打瞌睡，錯過了結尾。

examples.en: Passengers dozed quietly on the night train.
examples.zh: 夜車上的乘客安靜地打著瞌睡。

examples.en: He took a short doze on the sofa before dinner.
examples.zh: 他在晚餐前在沙發上小睡了一下。

examples.en: A quick doze helped me feel fresh again.
examples.zh: 小睡片刻讓我又恢復了精神。

examples.en: She had a doze on the bus ride home.
examples.zh: 她在回家的公車上打了個盹。

examples.en: The duration of the movie is about two hours.
examples.zh: 這部電影的片長大約兩小時。

examples.en: Please keep your phone off for the duration of the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間請將手機關機。

examples.en: The course is short in duration but very useful.
examples.zh: 這門課時間不長，但非常實用。

examples.en: We walked along the beach at dusk.
examples.zh: 我們在黃昏時沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: The street lights come on at dusk.
examples.zh: 路燈在傍晚時亮起。

examples.en: Bats start flying around the park at dusk.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠在黃昏時開始在公園裡飛來飛去。

examples.en: These mushrooms are edible, but those red ones are not.
examples.zh: 這些蘑菇可以吃，但那些紅色的不行。

examples.en: The cake was so hard that it was barely edible.
examples.zh: 那個蛋糕硬到幾乎無法食用。

examples.en: The decorations on the table are all edible.
examples.zh: 桌上的裝飾品全都可以吃。

examples.en: The newspaper published an editorial about public transportation.
examples.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇關於大眾運輸的社論。

examples.en: She wrote an editorial on school lunches for the student paper.
examples.zh: 她替校刊寫了一篇關於學校營養午餐的社論。

examples.en: Today's editorial praises the city's new recycling program.
examples.zh: 今天的社論稱讚這座城市新的資源回收計畫。

examples.en: The editorial staff meets every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 編輯部人員每週一早上開會。

examples.en: He made several editorial changes to the report.
examples.zh: 他對報告做了幾處編輯上的修改。

examples.en: The magazine has a strong editorial team.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌有一支堅強的編輯團隊。

examples.en: We called an electrician to fix the broken light switch.
examples.zh: 我們請了電工來修壞掉的電燈開關。

examples.en: My uncle works as an electrician for a construction company.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在一家建設公司當電工。

examples.en: The electrician checked all the wires before turning on the power.
examples.zh: 電工在開電源前檢查了所有的電線。

examples.en: Running a marathon requires great endurance.
examples.zh: 跑馬拉松需要很強的耐力。

examples.en: The team showed real endurance in the final match.
examples.zh: 球隊在決賽中展現出真正的持久力。

examples.en: Her endurance helped her finish the long hike.
examples.zh: 她的耐力幫助她完成了這次長程健行。

examples.en: Good lighting can enhance the look of a room.
examples.zh: 良好的照明可以提升房間的質感。

examples.en: Reading every day will enhance your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 每天閱讀會增加你的字彙量。

examples.en: The new software enhances the quality of old photos.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體能改善舊照片的畫質。

examples.en: She decided to enroll in a night class at the community college.
examples.zh: 她決定到社區大學報名夜間課程。

examples.en: Parents must enroll their children before the school year starts.
examples.zh: 家長必須在學年開始前替孩子辦理入學。

examples.en: Over two hundred students enrolled in the summer program.
examples.zh: 有兩百多名學生報名了暑期課程。

examples.en: The examiner asked me to introduce myself in English.
examples.zh: 主考官請我用英文自我介紹。

examples.en: Each examiner watches ten students during the test.
examples.zh: 每位考官在考試中負責監看十名學生。

examples.en: An examiner from the health department visited the restaurant.
examples.zh: 衛生局的檢查員來到這家餐廳視察。

examples.en: Grandma's eyesight is getting worse as she gets older.
examples.zh: 奶奶年紀越大，視力越差。

examples.en: Eating carrots is said to be good for your eyesight.
examples.zh: 據說吃紅蘿蔔對視力有益。

examples.en: He has excellent eyesight and can read the small sign from far away.
examples.zh: 他視力極佳，從很遠的地方就能看清楚小告示。

examples.en: The teacher read us a fable about a clever fox.
examples.zh: 老師唸了一則關於聰明狐狸的寓言給我們聽。

examples.en: Every fable ends with a lesson about life.
examples.zh: 每則寓言都以一個人生教訓作結。

examples.en: This old fable is still popular with children around the world.
examples.zh: 這則古老的寓言深受世界各地孩子的喜愛。

examples.en: The farmer spread fertilizer over the rice field.
examples.zh: 農夫把肥料撒在稻田裡。

examples.en: Too much fertilizer can harm young plants.
examples.zh: 太多肥料可能傷害幼苗。

examples.en: We bought a bag of fertilizer for the garden.
examples.zh: 我們替花園買了一袋肥料。

examples.en: The fragrance of fresh flowers filled the living room.
examples.zh: 新鮮花朵的香味瀰漫了客廳。

examples.en: She wore a light fragrance to the interview.
examples.zh: 她面試時擦了淡淡的香水。

examples.en: This soap has a pleasant lemon fragrance.
examples.zh: 這塊肥皂有宜人的檸檬香味。

examples.en: The freeway was crowded with cars during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假日期間，高速公路上擠滿了車。

examples.en: We took the freeway to save time.
examples.zh: 我們走高速公路以節省時間。

examples.en: There is a freeway exit near our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校附近有一個高速公路出口。

examples.en: The old movie is about a famous gangster in the 1930s.
examples.zh: 這部老電影講的是一九三○年代一位著名的幫派份子。

examples.en: The author wrote a novel about a gangster who wanted a new life.
examples.zh: 作者寫了一本小說，內容是一個想展開新生活的幫派份子。

examples.en: Police say the gangster has left the city.
examples.zh: 警方表示那名幫派份子已經離開這座城市。

examples.en: The city holds a parade to celebrate gay rights every year.
examples.zh: 這座城市每年都舉辦遊行來慶祝同志權益。

examples.en: He has many gay friends at work.
examples.zh: 他在公司有很多同志朋友。

examples.en: The film tells a touching story about a gay couple.
examples.zh: 這部電影描述了一對同志伴侶的動人故事。

examples.en: The law protects gays from unfair treatment at work.
examples.zh: 法律保障同志在職場上不受不公平的對待。

examples.en: The group helps young gays feel accepted.
examples.zh: 這個團體幫助年輕的同志感到被接納。

examples.en: Many gays and lesbians joined the community event.
examples.zh: 許多男同志與女同志參加了這場社區活動。

examples.en: The swan glided across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 天鵝滑過平靜的湖面。

examples.en: Eagles glide high above the mountains without moving their wings.
examples.zh: 老鷹不拍動翅膀，在高山上空滑翔。

examples.en: The skater glided smoothly over the ice.
examples.zh: 溜冰選手在冰面上順暢地滑行。

examples.en: The bird made a long glide down to the river.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥長長地滑翔到河面。

examples.en: She finished her routine with a graceful glide.
examples.zh: 她以優雅的滑行結束了她的表演。

examples.en: The plane made a gentle glide toward the runway.
examples.zh: 飛機平穩地滑翔，朝跑道降落。

examples.en: I drink a glass of grapefruit juice every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上都喝一杯葡萄柚汁。

examples.en: This grapefruit is a little bitter but very fresh.
examples.zh: 這顆葡萄柚有點苦，但很新鮮。

examples.en: She cut the grapefruit in half and shared it with me.
examples.zh: 她把葡萄柚切成兩半，和我分著吃。

senses.zh: 障礙；不利條件；身心障礙

examples.en: Not speaking the local language was a big handicap for him.
examples.zh: 不會說當地語言對他是個很大的不利條件。

examples.en: The school has ramps for students with a physical handicap.
examples.zh: 學校為身體有障礙的學生設置了坡道。

examples.en: Being short is not a handicap in this sport.
examples.zh: 個子矮在這項運動中並不是劣勢。

examples.en: A lack of money will handicap the young team.
examples.zh: 缺乏資金會讓這支年輕的球隊處於不利地位。

examples.en: Bad weather handicapped the rescue work.
examples.zh: 惡劣的天氣妨礙了救援工作。

examples.en: Slow internet can handicap online learning.
examples.zh: 網路太慢會妨礙線上學習。

examples.en: The cement will harden in about two hours.
examples.zh: 水泥大約兩小時後會變硬。

examples.en: Cold weather hardened the soil in the garden.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天氣讓花園裡的土壤變硬了。

examples.en: Years of hard work hardened her spirit.
examples.zh: 多年的辛勤工作磨練了她的意志。

examples.en: The movie is about a plot to hijack a plane.
examples.zh: 這部電影的內容是一項劫機的陰謀。

examples.en: Hackers tried to hijack the company's website.
examples.zh: 駭客企圖劫持這家公司的網站。

examples.en: Some people tried to hijack the meeting with unrelated topics.
examples.zh: 有些人想用無關的話題來把持會議。

examples.en: The airline trained its staff to handle a hijack.
examples.zh: 航空公司訓練員工應對劫機事件。

examples.en: The news story reported a hijack in the 1970s.
examples.zh: 這則新聞報導了一九七○年代的一起劫機事件。

examples.en: The hijack ended safely after a few hours.
examples.zh: 這起劫持事件在幾小時後平安落幕。

senses.zh: 青年旅館；背包客棧；宿舍

examples.en: We stayed at a cheap hostel near the train station.
examples.zh: 我們住在火車站附近一間便宜的青年旅館。

examples.en: The hostel offers free breakfast for all guests.
examples.zh: 這間青年旅館提供所有房客免費早餐。

examples.en: She met travelers from many countries at the hostel.
examples.zh: 她在青年旅館認識了來自許多國家的旅客。

examples.en: The ship carefully avoided the huge iceberg.
examples.zh: 那艘船小心地避開了巨大的冰山。

examples.en: Most of an iceberg is hidden under the water.
examples.zh: 冰山的大部分都藏在水面下。

examples.en: Scientists studied a giant iceberg near the South Pole.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了南極附近的一座巨大冰山。

examples.en: The imperial palace attracts thousands of tourists every year.
examples.zh: 這座皇宮每年吸引數千名遊客。

examples.en: The museum displays gifts from the imperial family.
examples.zh: 博物館展出皇室家族的禮物。

examples.en: The recipe uses imperial measurements such as ounces and pounds.
examples.zh: 這份食譜使用盎司和磅等英制單位。

examples.en: The country began to industrialize in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 這個國家在十九世紀開始工業化。

examples.en: Many nations want to industrialize their economies quickly.
examples.zh: 許多國家希望讓經濟快速工業化。

examples.en: Cities grew fast as the region started to industrialize.
examples.zh: 隨著這個地區開始工業化，城市快速成長。

examples.en: From her smile, I inferred that she passed the test.
examples.zh: 從她的笑容，我推斷她通過了考試。

examples.en: What can you infer from this graph?
examples.zh: 你能從這張圖表推論出什麼？

examples.en: Readers can infer the writer's opinion from the title.
examples.zh: 讀者可以從標題推斷作者的看法。

examples.en: The town has about five thousand inhabitants.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮大約有五千名居民。

examples.en: The inhabitants of the island rely on fishing.
examples.zh: 島上的居民靠捕魚維生。

examples.en: Penguins are the only inhabitants of this icy coast.
examples.zh: 企鵝是這片冰冷海岸唯一的居民。

examples.en: The interpreter translated the speech into English.
examples.zh: 口譯員把演講翻成了英文。

examples.en: We hired an interpreter for our business meeting in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我們為在東京的商務會議請了一位口譯員。

examples.en: She works as a sign language interpreter at the hospital.
examples.zh: 她在醫院擔任手語翻譯員。

examples.en: I am sorry to intrude, but may I ask a question?
examples.zh: 很抱歉打擾，我可以問個問題嗎？

examples.en: Reporters should not intrude on people's private lives.
examples.zh: 記者不該侵擾別人的私生活。

examples.en: A stranger intruded into our private party.
examples.zh: 一位陌生人闖進了我們的私人派對。

examples.en: The alarm rang when an intruder entered the building.
examples.zh: 有人闖入大樓時，警報器響了。

examples.en: The dog barked loudly at the intruder.
examples.zh: 狗對著闖入者大聲吠叫。

examples.en: The security camera recorded the intruder's face.
examples.zh: 監視器拍下了闖入者的臉。

examples.en: I have an itch on my back that I cannot reach.
examples.zh: 我背上有個地方癢，搆不到。

examples.en: The cream stopped the itch right away.
examples.zh: 這條藥膏馬上止住了癢。

examples.en: An itch from the mosquito bite kept him awake.
examples.zh: 蚊子叮咬造成的癢讓他睡不著。

examples.en: My arm itches after the mosquito bite.
examples.zh: 被蚊子叮之後，我的手臂發癢。

examples.en: The new wool sweater itches a little.
examples.zh: 這件新的羊毛衣有點刺癢。

examples.en: He is itching to try the new game.
examples.zh: 他迫不及待想玩這款新遊戲。

senses.zh: 知識淵博的；見多識廣的

examples.en: Our guide was very knowledgeable about local history.
examples.zh: 我們的導遊對當地歷史非常了解。

examples.en: She is a knowledgeable teacher who loves answering questions.
examples.zh: 她是一位學識淵博、喜歡回答問題的老師。

examples.en: The shop staff are friendly and knowledgeable about computers.
examples.zh: 這家店的店員很親切，對電腦也很在行。

examples.en: My landlady lives on the first floor of the building.
examples.zh: 我的女房東住在這棟樓的一樓。

examples.en: The landlady raised the rent last month.
examples.zh: 女房東上個月調漲了房租。

examples.en: The landlady of the inn welcomed us with hot tea.
examples.zh: 旅館的女老闆端了熱茶來歡迎我們。

senses.zh: 山崩；土石流；壓倒性勝利

examples.en: A landslide blocked the mountain road after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，山崩堵住了山路。

examples.en: The village was damaged by a landslide last summer.
examples.zh: 這座村莊去年夏天被土石流破壞。

examples.en: The mayor won the election by a landslide.
examples.zh: 市長以壓倒性的票數贏得選舉。

examples.en: Taipei is located at a latitude of about twenty-five degrees north.
examples.zh: 台北位於北緯約二十五度。

examples.en: Places at high latitude have very long winters.
examples.zh: 高緯度的地方冬天很長。

examples.en: The teacher gave students some latitude in choosing their topics.
examples.zh: 老師讓學生在選題上有一些自由。

examples.en: The army liberated the city in 1945.
examples.zh: 軍隊在一九四五年解放了這座城市。

examples.en: Volunteers liberated the birds from the small cages.
examples.zh: 志工把鳥從小籠子裡放了出來。

examples.en: Technology can liberate people from boring housework.
examples.zh: 科技可以讓人從無聊的家事中解放出來。

examples.en: Please lighten your bag before the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行前，請減輕你背包的重量。

examples.en: A joke from the teacher lightened the mood in the classroom.
examples.zh: 老師的一個笑話讓教室的氣氛輕鬆起來。

examples.en: We painted the walls to lighten the dark room.
examples.zh: 我們粉刷牆壁，讓昏暗的房間變亮。

examples.en: I put lotion on my hands after washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 洗完碗後，我在手上擦乳液。

examples.en: This sunscreen lotion is safe for children.
examples.zh: 這款防曬乳液對孩子很安全。

examples.en: She bought a bottle of body lotion at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 她在藥妝店買了一瓶身體乳液。

examples.en: The principal's voice came through the loudspeaker.
examples.zh: 校長的聲音從擴音器傳出來。

examples.en: A loudspeaker on the train announced the next stop.
examples.zh: 火車上的擴音器廣播了下一站。

examples.en: They placed a large loudspeaker on the stage for the concert.
examples.zh: 他們在舞台上放了一個大喇叭來辦音樂會。

examples.en: Mom sang a lullaby to help the baby fall asleep.
examples.zh: 媽媽唱搖籃曲幫寶寶入睡。

examples.en: The soft lullaby made me feel sleepy.
examples.zh: 輕柔的搖籃曲讓我覺得想睡。

examples.en: Grandma still remembers the lullaby she sang to us.
examples.zh: 奶奶還記得她以前唱給我們聽的搖籃曲。

examples.en: The lunar eclipse could be seen from our balcony.
examples.zh: 我們從陽台就能看到月蝕。

examples.en: Our family gets together every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我們全家每年農曆新年都會團聚。

examples.en: Scientists studied rocks brought back from the lunar surface.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了從月球表面帶回來的岩石。

examples.en: Can I help you, madam?
examples.zh: 女士，需要我幫忙嗎？

examples.en: Dear Madam, I am writing to ask about the job.
examples.zh: 敬啟者，我來信是想詢問這份工作。

examples.en: Madam Chair, I would like to make a suggestion.
examples.zh: 主席女士，我想提出一項建議。

examples.en: Ferries run between the island and the mainland every hour.
examples.zh: 渡輪每小時往返於島嶼與本土之間。

examples.en: We took a boat from the island to the mainland.
examples.zh: 我們搭船從島上到本土。

examples.en: Many tourists from the mainland visit the island in summer.
examples.zh: 許多來自大陸的遊客在夏天造訪這座島。

examples.en: The mainland coast is only ten kilometers away.
examples.zh: 本土的海岸線只有十公里遠。

examples.en: Mainland weather is often different from the island's.
examples.zh: 本土的天氣常常和島上不同。

examples.en: They live in a mainland town near the sea.
examples.zh: 他們住在靠海的一座本土城鎮。
